facts.source_fact: The transferring operator and proposed new operator must jointly apply to transfer an HSE permit when the installation changes operator.
A joint transfer application is also required for a change to the legal entity operating the installation.
The new operator must register the installation on METS.
Both operators complete different parts of the transfer application before submission.
Either party may pay the required fee.
The new operator must submit a new monitoring plan or identify parts of the existing plan it proposes to vary.
An HSE permit cannot be partially transferred.
Transfer applications are submitted through METS unless the regulator agrees otherwise.
Applications must include information required by the Order and any required fee.
The regulator must determine an application within two months unless a longer period is agreed.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve determination window without treating application as approval.
